source_anchor: Literal-function H integral from AppendixB2.2 definition through Ex58 and the Fubini/Gaussian/B6 computation Eq21. Prove genuine joint absolute Haar-times-Euclidean-volume integrability of original and radialized integrands, and exact displayed closed scalar expectation. No actual Gaussian probability-law/density identification, target-mixture/TV interpretation, sphere/Poisson or main lower-bound claim.

proposed_signatures.literal_mixture_transform:
theorem literal_mixture_transform {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
            (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let f : (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        (Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖z.2‖ ^ 2) * p z.1 z.2)
    let g : (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ z.1).det /
          (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-a z.1 * ‖z.2‖ ^ 2 / 4)
    Integrable f ((orthogonalHaar n).prod volume) ∧
    Integrable g ((orthogonalHaar n).prod volume) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * p O x)
        ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) /
            (a O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ∂orthogonalHaar n)

meaning_definitions.orthogonalHaar: Identical canonical actual full O(n) Borel Haar probability, not an arbitrary law.
meaning_definitions.p: Literal real precision formula on actual Euclidean space coordinates; no Gaussian measure definition or density characterization.
meaning_definitions.f: Original determinant-weighted test times literal formula on actual product measure.
meaning_definitions.g: Radialized same integrand after exact axis exponent, actual product measure.
meaning_definitions.space: EuclideanSpace R (Fin n) has actual Euclidean norm and canonical volume, WithLp.ofLp supplies coordinates; all n/2 powers are real.

TYPING: full orthogonal group; actual canonical Haar probability and Euclidean volume
